qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the pump assembly to metal-bonded mount?
What torque should be applied to the holder to fuel pump or fuel reservoir?
What is the torque specification for electric connections on fuel pump using M4 screws?
What torque value is specified for M5 electric connections on fuel pump?
Which components require the highest torque specification in the fuel supply system?
qa_pairs.answer: The pump assembly to metal-bonded mount and holder to fuel pump or fuel reservoir both require 6.5 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What type of vehicles do the fuel pump electric connection specifications apply to?
What is the difference in torque between M4 and M5 electric connections on fuel pump?
qa_pairs.answer: M5 connections require 0.4 Nm more torque than M4 connections (1.6 Nm vs 1.2 Nm)
